children.name: Changing location help
children.text: Changing cluster starts a fresh draft. The chosen cluster handles all creation steps.

children.name: HeadingDesc
children.text: Pick the version and loader for this server. Each loader keeps its own mods on a separate volume, so switching never clobbers another.

children.name: Tip
children.text: Memory tip. Factor in mod/plugin overhead; Minecraft Vanilla uses ~1.5 GB at 4 players.
